The student shows aggression, yelling, and occasional task refusal during difficult work.

The behavior occurs 3 times per day and can last 10 minutes. Baseline data shows these behaviors increase during difficult tasks.

The BIP is in place. OT services are provided. A visual schedule and a break card are used in class.

The behavior appears to be maintained by escape and attention. No self-injury or elopement were noted in the documentation.
